title: SB814 (2018 Regular): Public Safety - Permit to Carry, Wear, or Transport a Handgun - Qualifications

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2018RS/bills/sb/sb0814f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader: the bill as filed. Quote joins the lead-in with item (6)(ii); items (1)-(5) and (6)(i) are unchanged law. No passage vote in the record.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–306(a)): Subject to subsection (c) of this section, the Secretary shall issue a permit within a reasonable time to a person who the Secretary finds: (6) based on an investigation: (ii) has good and substantial reason to wear, carry, or transport a handgun, such as SELF–DEFENSE OR a finding that the permit is necessary as a reasonable precaution against apprehended danger.
